task.title: Total quantity by product category
task.statement: Using products and sales, return each product category and the total quantity sold in that category. Join the tables by product_id and group the result by category.
expected_evidence: Join related tables, then aggregate sale quantities at category granularity.

hidden_variables.name: additional_category
hidden_variables.purpose: Require the grouping and join to generalize to unseen categories.

private.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products AS p JOIN sales AS s ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category
hints: Identify the relationship between products and sales.
Join sales to products before grouping.
The category is the grouping key and quantity is the value to sum.
private.solution_explanation: The join associates each sale with its product category, and SUM(quantity) calculates the total for each category.
